response.content: {"critique": "The problem is reserve-change approvals stuck when the approver is on leave without a delegate. None of the five similar items address approver delegation, leave coverage, or approval routing: supplier address fields (in progress), reserve history audit export, bulk document upload (completed), organisation settings (unstarted, only covers general permissions), and claim search refinements (completed) all concern different problems. No shipped story or roadmap item solves or covers the approval-delegation issue, so the problem remains open.", "verdict": "pass"}
